'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Scott Lingrell LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
